column1: # Reds in main's whole gate (gate-logs/<sha12>/<stamp>/full-main) that are explained, so push-main.sh's pause
# rule lets landings through them. One line each: the log ref, a tab, what caused it and what fixed it.

column2: UNEXPLAINED, under investigation (pause lifted by @system_adamic 19:59 MDT; no landing caused it): internal/native TestWASI/regions.a, a reference-side failure. The oracle's Node leg (Node v24.19.0) running regions.a's source failed "CompileError: WebAssembly.Module(): Compiling function #481 failed: not enough arguments on the stack for block (need 5, got 0) @+1472652", a 1.4 MB module inside Node that fits its own type stripper (amaro, built to wasm), not Adamic's output; the WASI leg printed the right output. 1 red in 4 runs on the Threadripper at load 196 to 292 of 64 threads: regions.a alone and whole TestWASI twice (37/0/0 each) pass on rerun. Addressed by the 20:30 cut (full gate niced and capped); the oracle keeps stderr on failure.

LIFTED under the 20:05 rule, OPEN until its fix lands (a second TestRunnerLocationIdentity red before then pauses with no lift): cmd/adamic-test262 TestRunnerLocationIdentity (edit_test.go:180), two helper runs of identical runner bytes printed different identity hashes. Owner @system_adamic_developer_tools; cause class test harness (the identity hashes platform, uid, cwd, stack limit, the whole environment and the runner/node/clang bytes, and the red showed only two hashes, so which part moved is unknown). Reruns alone on 8b388310 pass: Threadripper plain go test 40.4 s, the full gate's way (chrt --idle 0, ionice -c3, nice 19) 72.2 s, the single test 20 times 20/20; Kirk's Mac twice (integration 0.55 s, @system_adamic 0.54 s). Fix by 23:12 MDT: devtools/test262-identity-parts 5f3e82b0 prints every part and names the differing ones on a mismatch.
